title: Darr Equipment
description: darrequipment.com Revenue $304.6 Mil Darreq Equipment is a specialty equipment rental company founded in 2010 in Denver, Colorado, with a second office in Bozeman, Montana, serving the Mountain West region including Colorado, Wyoming and Montana. With 50 to 100 employees and estimated revenue of 10 to 25 million dollars, it provides mobile generators, transformers, chillers, dehumidifiers, compressors, light towers and temporary infrastructure for construction, oil and gas, mining, healthcare and data center clients. It distinguishes itself from mass-market rental companies like United Rentals by focusing on specialized high-demand equipment for complex projects. The company operates its own delivery fleet with 24/7 emergency response capability. Key sectors include large-scale construction, energy projects, disaster recovery and data center cooling. Its niche approach avoids direct competition with national rental giants while serving demanding industrial clients in the Mountain West.
